title: Cloud Storage, Object Lifecycle, and Enterprise File Systems — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Maps Cloud Storage and Enterprise Filesystems: details storage classes (Standard, Nearline, Coldline, Archive), Autoclass, and Filestore NFS shares.
routing_rationale: Cloud Storage provides 99.999999999% (11 9s) annual durability across multi-region geographic redundancy, supporting object lifecycle management and uniform access.

nodes.label: Client Ingestion SDK
nodes.detail: Uploads multipart media files and transactional ledger documents.

nodes.label: Autoclass Engine
nodes.detail: Monitors access patterns; transitions inactive data to cheaper tiers automatically.

nodes.label: Standard Storage Tier
nodes.detail: Frequent access storage with high IOPS and zero retrieval fees.

nodes.label: Bucket Lock (WORM)
nodes.detail: Immutable compliance lock: prevents deletion or overwrite for 7 years (SEC 17a-4).

nodes.label: Filestore Enterprise
nodes.detail: POSIX shared filesystem mounted simultaneously across 50 GKE worker pods.

steps.title: Multipart Ingestion
steps.action: Client initiates resumable upload; object chunks replicated across multi-region facilities.
steps.why_traversal: Multi-region dual-region replication guarantees 11 9s data durability.

steps.title: Automated Tiering
steps.action: Autoclass transitions data untouched for 90 days from Standard to Coldline.
steps.why_traversal: Reduces monthly storage cost by 70% without changing application bucket paths.

steps.title: WORM Retention Enforcement
steps.action: Bucket Lock policy locks retention period; prevents deletion even by project owners.
steps.why_traversal: Guarantees SEC 17a-4 and financial regulatory compliance.

scenarios.label: Unauthorized Deletion Intercept
scenarios.root_cause: Rogue administrator script executed gsutil rm -r on compliance bucket.
scenarios.diverted_path: Cloud Storage rejects command with HTTP 403 Retention Policy Locked.
scenarios.blast_radius: Zero data loss; compliance documents preserved.
scenarios.recovery: Bucket Lock cannot be bypassed until retention timestamp expires.
